title: 2022 AMC 10A Problem 6
statement: Which expression is equal to \[\left|a-2-\sqrt{(a-1)^2}\right|\] for \(a < 0?\)

solutions.text:
By the definition of square root, we get that \[\sqrt{(a - 1)^2} = |a - 1|.\]

Since \(a < 0,\) we get that \(a - 1 < 0,\) which means that \(|a - 1| = 1 - a.\)

The whole expression therefore simplifies to \[ |a - 2 - (1 - a)| = |2a - 3|. \] Since \(a < 0,\) we know that \(2a - 3 < 0.\) This means that \(|2a - 3| = 3 - 2a.\)

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Replace the square root of a square by an absolute value
Use the sign of each expression when a is negative
